sentences.englishText: Martyr comes from the Arabic word "şehid".
A person who dies in the cause of sacred ideals, religion or belief.
sentences.turkishText: Kutsal bir ülkü, din veya inanç uğrunda ölen kimsedir.

sentences.englishText: The action of being a martyr is called "şehadet".
All of those who die while defending their country, nation and flag are martyrs.
sentences.turkishText: Vatanını, milletini ve bayrağını müdafaa yolunda ölen herkes şehittir.
